$comment: Essential Eight → SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria mappings. Derived from AICPA TSC 2017 (rev. 2022) and Drata's published cross-walk. Mappings are 'partial' because TSC criteria are outcome-based while E8 is technique-specific.

mappings.rationale: Restricting unauthorised software is a logical access control to prevent malicious software.
Centralised log monitoring of execution events.
Timely analysis of events to identify incidents.
Vulnerability detection + remediation SLA.
Vulnerability detection + remediation SLA across the application catalogue.
Annual penetration testing supports ongoing evaluations.
Disabled-by-default macros prevent malicious software execution.
Centralised macro execution event logging.
Browser hardening / locked settings.
ASR + Constrained Language Mode.
Logical access controls restricting administrative privileges.
Validated requests + segregation of admin and standard accounts.
Periodic revalidation of access (12-month / 45-day inactivity).
JIT admin reduces standing access; Memory Integrity / Credential Guard reduce credential theft risk.
OS vulnerability detection + remediation SLA.
Tightened OS patch SLA.
MFA is a logical access control.
Phishing-resistant MFA for privileged users.
MFA for accessing important data repositories.
Backups + restoration testing supports availability.
Privileged accounts cannot tamper with backups during retention.
Immutable, segmented backups.
